description.html: This 30x20x25 cm terrarium (15 L) comes with a polystyrene 3D background that faithfully reproduces the texture of stone or bark. Hand-sculpted and painted in natural tones, the background is more than decoration: it adds surfaces for climbing and hiding.

The horizontal layout with 30 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Proper thermoregulation depends on this layout: the animal moves between the warmer and cooler zones as needed. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
